Beads and Pegboards

I tend to purchase all my beads online. You can find pretty much any color or brand you're interested in. Most places sell beads one of two ways: large containers with a random assortment of colors (sometimes according to some theme like "pastel" or "halloween") or in single colors bags of roughly 1000 beads. I say roughly because these are usually filled by weight, rather than count, so they may be slightly more or slightly less. Most places that sell fuse beads will also sell pegboards.

Here is a list of some of the more popular online stores that I'm aware of along with a little info about them:

Retailer Brand Selection Notes
Perler Perler Official site for Perler beads
Hama Hama Official site for Hama beads
Nabbi Nabbi Official site for Nabbi beads, with list of online retailers
Bakers'KidsCrafts Perler, Hama, Nabbi, and Artkal Also sells the "mini" beads from some brands
Hobby Access Perler, Artkal
HamaBeads.com Hama Sells all sizes of Hama beads
Michaels Perler May have better selection in-store
JoAnn Perler
KoolStuff4Kids Perler Weekly deals on beads/supplies
Creativ Nabbi

There are many people selling fuse beads of various brands on eBay and Amazon, as well.

Many local craft stores also have a stock of fuse beads and pegboards, but often only a single brand and a relatively small selection of colors. They can be a great place to find staples like black and white if you're in a pinch and don't want to wait for an online order to arrive, though.
